text: yo these rock hell yeah. how about some beds, cupboards, mirror, sink, oven, fridge, telephone pole, maybe some different color chairs. maybe a basket ball hoop, computer. nice work so far tho
resolution: Added the requested household + utility batch: 13 new prop kinds end-to-end. Beds (single with teal blanket + one pillow; double widens to 1.5m with two pillows + maroon blanket; headboard at +X; both get yaw-aware thin collision so you can walk alongside), cupboard (tall two-door wardrobe with knobs, thin AABB), mirror (wall-decor family: metal frame, pale glass, diagonal glint stripe), sink (pedestal + basin + faucet), oven (four burners, door window, handle bar), fridge (two-door with seam + bar handles), computer (CRT monitor + keyboard + tower at its anchor so it drops onto tables/desks or the floor), three painted chair variants (red/blue/green diner chairs with metal legs, same body as the wood chair), telephone pole (8.5m timber with two crossarms + insulator pegs — wires left for a future catenary pass), and a basketball hoop (pole, white backboard with target square, orange torus rim at the regulation 3.05m). Every kind has defs in both registries (world/propKinds.ts + game/kinds/props.ts), a live Scene3D model, compiled instance-part recipes in worldGeometry.ts, and catalog material/cover/depth tags so it auto-appears in the build palette. Verified: kinds/props 8/8, build 18/18, editor cart + gameShell + compile entry bundle clean.
